1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said light emitting diodes are positioned to form a pattern that is uniquely configured to enhance light distribution compared to typical diode arrangements.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open, and wherein said open second end is structured to facilitate heat dissipation.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are configured to emit light at different angles from each other.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, and the shape is optimized to improve aerodynamic flow over the lamp.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, wherein the spatial arrangement minimizes shadowing effects in light emission.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes, wherein the configuration promotes efficient airflow.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein the optic element is designed to enhance the uniformity of the emitted light.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material that is specifically selected to maximize light conversion efficiency.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, wherein the element enhances thermal performance in conjunction with the fins.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, specifically configured for improved electrical contacts.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including advanced circuitry for optimizing LED performance.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body and is designed to minimize light loss.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline optimized for thermal management.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, wherein the method includes integrating cooling elements during the assembly process.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 180 W/mK.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins configured to enhance thermal efficiency.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls optimized for manufacturing efficiency and thermal stability.
